Resolves #18758

The #4606 Enter/click toggle runs again. A menu's submenu lookups now resolve through the record key `showSubMenu()` caches under, not the internalId a rendered node id has carried since #9071. `showSubMenu()` also hides a sibling's submenu before showing its own, so the revived toggle cannot strand one.

Evidence: L3 (component spec drives real clicks in Chromium; unit specs pin the cache contract) → L3 required (AC-3). No residual.

## AC Evidence

| AC-1 | `test/playwright/unit/menu/List.spec.mjs` › submenu cache › *Enter on a parent whose submenu is showing closes it…* — both arms, keyed by its id and keyed by the store |
| AC-2 | same file › *showing a sibling's submenu unmounts the one showing before it* |
| AC-3 | `test/playwright/component/menu/List.spec.mjs` › parent click › *a second click on a parent hides the submenu its first click showed* — level counts `[2, 1]` |
| AC-4 | CI `unit` + `components` |

## Deltas from ticket

`onSelect()` drops its always-true guard and reduces to show-or-hide. With the toggle live, that guard would have hidden and remounted a submenu the toggle had just shown.

## Test Evidence

Red-first: the three unit arms failed against unchanged source (the lookup missed, so the submenu stayed showing; the sibling stayed mounted). The component arm failed at `845dc2d900` with `origin/dev`'s `src/menu/List.mjs` checked out: expected 1 menu, received 2. With the fix: menu unit specs 43/43, menu component specs 12/12.

agent-preflight: not hosted here; the baseline jobs run in CI.

- [ ] `examples/button/base`: a second click on `Item 3` hides its submenu, and a third shows it again.

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge — `activeSubMenu` can go stale, and the exclusivity guard trusts it.** `showSubMenu()` only mounts when `me.activeSubMenu !== subMenu`. A submenu that unmounts *itself* — `onKeyDownEscape()` → `this.floating && this.unmount()` — never clears `parentMenu.activeSubMenu`; `unmount()` clears only its own child. If the parent then toggles the same record, `toggleSubMenu()` sees `!mounted`, calls `showSubMenu()`, and the guard skips the mount. I could not reach it from a user gesture today: focus leaving the submenu drives `onFocusLeave` → `menuFocus = false` → the root's `afterSetMenuFocus` unmounts or `hideSubMenu()`s the cascade, which clears the pointer within the focus manager's leave gap. So this is a watch, not a finding — but #18759 (hover-shown submenus) is exactly the lane likely to add a close path with no focus change. Keying the guard on `!subMenu.mounted`, or clearing the parent's pointer in `unmount()`, would make it independent of the cascade.
